comments.author: FSKnight
comments.body_html:
FOR ANYONE CONFUSED ON INSTALL:

1. Take 7zip File from Download, Extract It (Anywhere you can easily find the files, like your Desktop)
2. Open Folder
3. Drag .dll file to your BepInEx -> Plugins Folder.

Should work from there. To adjust settings to your liking, Press F12 in-game to open the Plugin/Mod Settings Menu

comments.author: FSKnight
comments.body_html:
Its supposed to hide the gear on your character, like Rigs/Armors/Helmets/Headsets/Glasses/Backpacks/Face Covers.

I believe the total intention of this is to get a better look at the GFL2 Character that this same mod author made (Which is fantastic) because its nice to look at a well-made model without all the bulky gear on (which especially looks not good on the GFL2 Character Models due to art style differences between the GFL2 Models and Tarkov’s Style) but its nice to not look at all the bulky gear on a character when using regular models.
